$comment: Custom ComfyUI nodes to provision. Each entry is git-cloned into ComfyUI/custom_nodes/<name> and checked out at the pinned ref. Update ref to bump a node. Run: npm run setup:comfyui-config

custom_nodes.$comment: PuLID (SDXL) identity reference — provides PulidModelLoader / PulidInsightFaceLoader / PulidEvaClipLoader / ApplyPulid used by the character-reference feature. Its requirements.txt (insightface, facexlib, onnxruntime, timm) is pip-installed by the provisioner. The SDXL weight (pulid_v1.1.safetensors) is a model file, not a node — fetch it with: npm run setup:pulid
custom_nodes.name: PuLID_ComfyUI

custom_nodes.$comment: NSFW auto-censor. Provides ApplyNudenet / NudenetModelLoader / FilterdLabel used by the video censoring feature (injectCensorNodes in src/lib/comfyui.ts). Detects targeted regions per frame and obscures them (pixelate/blur). Needs an ONNX detector under ComfyUI/models/Nudenet — fetch it with: npm run setup:comfyui-censor
custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI-Nudenet

custom_nodes.$comment: SAM2 (Segment Anything 2) segmentation + video mask propagation. Not yet wired into the shipped censor path (NudeNet handles detect+censor in-graph), but installed so a precise temporally-stable mask pass can be added later. Pairs with the already-installed Florence2 via its Florence2toCoordinates node. SAM2 checkpoints auto-download through its DownloadAndLoadSAM2Model node.
custom_nodes.name: ComfyUI-segment-anything-2
